title: ficus karet
intro: Ficus karet, commonly known as the Indian rubber tree or Malabar tree, is a plant species native to the tropical regions of Asia. The Indian rubber tree has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Ficus karet are attributed to its ability to reduce stress, improve sleep quality, and alleviate symptoms of anxiety and depression. The bioactive constituents of Ficus karet include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been studied for their potential in treating various health conditions.
